decisions.reason: As an agency-focused compliance tool close to the core offer and aligned with the firm's push on compliance capabilities, it likely meets or at least does not clearly miss aspiration levels, so management would keep it.

Because this platform is the flagship expression of the firm's strategic direction and uses core technical resources, behavioral management would continue backing it unless performance were unmistakably below aspiration.

This hosting plan fits the established business and can be carried in a growing market, but with less visible proof of traction and some overlap with the core offer it remains the most plausible candidate to be folded back or withdrawn if results disappoint.

Extended PHP security support strongly complements the firm's promise of secure, low-risk operations for agency clients, so management would usually retain it while monitoring whether demand reaches acceptable levels.
